items.label: sculpture, skulptur
desc: Hieroglyphic inscription that mentions Pa-Nefer, head of the cattle that belongs to Ramasseum.

items.label: amulet, crocodile, jewellery, smycke, amulett, krokodil, Sobek
desc: A ‘recumbent’ crocodile on an integral base. Highly stylized, still with some discernable details. Tail end is shown slightly twisted. Suspension hole through the body, at the point of its neck. Pale blue glaze.

items.label: relief, stele
desc: Round relief of limestone. Surface damaged, hieroglyphs and figures visible.

items.label: Mumie
desc:
Två mumifierade krokodilungar, den ena i sin linnebinda. Mumierna ligger i en avlång glaslåda vars hörn och kanter är sammanfogade med en blå textilarmerad klisterremsa.

Ur Knut Adrian Anderssons katalog II
